name: ask-johnny
description: A Discord bot. Johnny is dry, deadpan, and grudgingly competent — he remembers things, sets reminders, settles arguments, and tells you the real weather, all like it cost him effort. Provider-agnostic: any OpenAI-compatible model, configured in config/llm.json.

comments.groq-sdk: Removed 2026-09-07. Every provider Johnny can reach speaks the OpenAI chat-completions shape, so lib/llm.js calls it with plain fetch (Node 18+) and the provider becomes config, not a dependency. Removing the SDK also removed its maxRetries — that behaviour is rebuilt in lib/llm.js (see commit 2879e18 for why it matters).
comments.overrides: discord.js pins an undici that carries advisories (GHSA-8xcm-r25x-g524, GHSA-m8rv-5g2x-5cg5, GHSA-v3r7-h72x-cjcm). The old ^6.27.0 pin no longer clears them — the advisory range is <=6.27.0 — so this is now ^6.27.1. Re-check with `npm audit` after any discord.js bump; drop this override once discord.js ships a patched undici itself.
